title: Partner cannot survive the alliance horizon including the exit tail
notes: Design section A.4 [rbd 2.2]: partner financial distress such that the partner cannot survive the alliance horizon INCLUDING the exit tail (post-exit obligations, wind-down costs). Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until the thresholds meeting (ADR-0052 open questions; activation convention per ADR-0057). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: partner.financial_distress (form TBD) — 'red finding in machine-readable form' is itself the pending item.
